reviewer: Independent GATE bounded synthetic frozen-signal bridge review
acceptance_scope: New OHLCV-to-frozen-signal/adopted-event-allocation bridge and its incumbent synthetic interface only. Rejection concerns a reproduced frame/panel consistency defect. It does not reopen or reject the accepted ledger, adopted event rule or frozen strategy definitions.

blocking_findings.title: Incumbent non-Sunday early return bypasses frame/panel consistency
blocking_findings.finding: The incumbent returns None on non-Sunday decision closes before checking that the ledger frame's open/close prices agree with the frozen OHLCV panel. simulate_bridge checks profile/metadata but not per-frame prices before invoking the ledger. A Sunday-generated target executes at Monday open; its Monday frame is subsequently processed on a non-rebalance close and is never checked against the panel. The bridge can therefore report COMPLETE with fills and NAV derived from contradictory prices despite a fixed valid panel.

reproduction.inputs: All synthetic. Two symbols A/B with 61 complete UTC days of positive, varying prices and known hourly observations. Warm-up is Sunday 2026-01-04 23:00 UTC, decision close Monday 2026-01-05 00:00 UTC. The actual incumbent formula emits its scheduled target. Three following hourly frames use the same synthetic panel except A's first execution open is changed from 113.6738822299916 to 1.
reproduction.approximate_outcome: Baseline final NAV is approximately 1000.02 USD. The contradictory frame buys 500 A at raw price 1 and reports COMPLETE with final NAV approximately 57337.88 USD while the frozen panel still has the actual synthetic open above 113.
reproduction.expected: Reject or invalidate the contradictory frame and never report a complete valid return path from it. Weekly target scheduling must not bypass the input consistency boundary for prices used by fills or hourly marking.
reproduction.impact: Fictitious incumbent profit/exposure and invalid comparisons to the three default families. This is a new bridge-interface validation failure, not a defect in ledger settlement or the incumbent source target formula.

blocking_findings.required_closure: Separate incumbent frame/panel consistency validation from the Sunday-only target trigger. Preserve the intended weekly target schedule/no off-schedule rebalance. Add a regression using an actual Sunday target followed by a conflicting Monday execution open, asserting that the case cannot return COMPLETE; retain valid consistent-frame timing/formula and carry tests.
blocking_findings.coverage_gap: Current incumbent tests check Sunday formula/undefined volatility/history and that the next hour returns None, but do not perturb execution/valuation frame prices on non-rebalance hours.

reviewed_positive_boundaries.classification: SHOWN static and focused synthetic regression
reviewed_positive_boundaries.subject: Frozen families and event policy
reviewed_positive_boundaries.detail: Snapshot hash and family keys are pinned; configuration and panel inputs are copied, evidence emission is disabled, later config mutation refuses, and the real compute_signal receives completed/available contiguous 300-row windows. Event targets use exact fractions, a fixed 1/25 entry denominator, residual allocation, no all-HOLD rebalance and actual holdings rather than latched intentions. No defect in this event mapping was confirmed in the bounded pass.

reviewed_positive_boundaries.detail: The complete UTC 61-day window, last 30 daily population-return volatility, positive 28-day return, sqrt(365), half-account weight and Sunday close trigger match the tested frozen target formula.
